  "endpoint_class": "secondary-biomarker",
  "concordance_definition": "The paper defines concordance by comparing drug response metrics obtained in vitro (from 2D models, other 3D models, and the HuP3D model) with effective concentrations in patients from phase I or II studies that examined the pharmacokinetics of the tested chemotherapies (steady state concentration, Css). Pearson correlation coefficients (r) were calculated to measure the strength of these relationships.",
  "limitations_stated": [
    "The 'other 3D models' group included PDX, spheroids, organoids, and 3D scaffolds as a combinatory group, which complicates separate comparisons.",
    "The metrics E inf and GEC 50 did not correlate well with Css or with any of the other HuP3D metrics.",
    "A particular problem with GEC 50 is that this metric is relevant for drugs that have poor potency and that do not reach a GR value below 0.5. If the fit of the curve is not significantly better than that of a flat curve, the parameter is set to 0.",
    "Some problems also appear with E inf where, when the dose response curves reach a plateau at the highest tested concentrations, the value for E inf is similar to E max.",
    "E max depends on the concentration range used in the assay, thus, both metrics should be used with caution when comparing them to other studies using a different concentration range.",
    "The 2D cell culture models cannot efficiently predict the therapeutic response and the effective drug dose in cancer patients, due to their inability to represent the TME heterogeneity.",
    "Despite a good response in 2D tissue culture and PDX models, many patient tumors have shown a chemoresistance profile.",
    "The composition of the 3D model influences the drug response.",
    "There are clear differences between the cell growth rates in 2D and 3D platforms that make it difficult to compare the drug response metrics across them and even raises the question whether or not the same reporting tool should be used.",
    "Many difficulties can affect drug metrics comparisons, such as reporting an IC 50 value despite the fact that the drug was not effective enough to reduce the cell population by half.",
    "In some literature cases, EC 50 and GI 50 were confused for the IC 50.",
    "In highly potent drugs, the IC 50 does not differ much between publications, however, when the drug sensitivity is moderate or low, IC 50 values tend to be extremely variable in 2D and even more remarkably variable in 3D culture models.",
    "Drug response metric values may depend on the experiment protocol (medium, cell type, time of incubation, etc.), the composition of 3D models (stromal cells, ECM, different biomaterials, etc.), type or length of the assay, and the method of analysis (MTT, flow cytometry, ATP, etc.).",
    "Researchers can use different forms of a nonlinear regression equation to calculate the drug response metrics and utilize different methods to handle problems such as outliers.",
    "Some parameters cannot always be calculated due to the shape of the fitted curve (IC 50 , GEC 50 ) or when the cells do not grow exponentially (GR 50 ).",
    "Some parameters should be used carefully in a comparison analysis between assays with a different concentration range (E max and AUC).",
    "The forced 3D architecture incorporating cancer cell lines does not recapitulate the original tumor characteristics and cell-cell interactions with accessory tumor components."
  ],
  "funding_conflict": null,
  "key_numbers": [
    "About 90% of BCa deaths are contributed to recurrence or spread of the disease.",
    "About 80% of oncology drugs in clinical trials fail to receive FDA approval.",
    "Overall success rate of phase I-II clinical trials for cancer treatment is extremely low (3.4%).",
    "Lack of efficacy is the most common reason for failure (>50%) in clinical trials.",
    "A lack of antifibrinolytics resulted in a weight loss of about 16.98 ± 3.77 mg (around 5% to 9% loss of total weight) in HuP3D cultures after 24 days.",
    "Trans-4-(aminomethyl)cyclohexanecarboxylic acid (AMCHA) at 5 and 10 mg/mL resulted in the highest weight gain of about 24 mg (around 10% gain of total weight) in HuP3D cultures.",
    "BCa cell lines alone showed an increased proliferation of approximately 1.6-fold and 2-fold compared to day 0 at day 3 and 7, respectively.",
    "Co-culture with a TME significantly increased cell proliferation to 3-fold in all BCa cell lines tested at day 7.",
    "HuP3D cultures showed a significant 6-fold increase in EVs compared to 2D cultures.",
    "EV particles/mL baseline control of just plasma in media with no cells was increased by about 2-fold and 10-fold in 2D and HuP3D cultures, respectively.",
    "Baseline plasma in media and no cells showed 0.14 µg/µL EVs, while 2D and HuP3D cultures showed a significant increase of about 1.3-fold and 1.53-fold, respectively.",
    "A very weak positive correlation (r = 0.11) existed for the comparison of 2D IC 50 to clinical Css values.",
    "Moderate (r = 0.42) to strong (r = 0.82) correlations were revealed for IC 50 values of other 3D models and the HuP3D culture model compared to the clinical Css, respectively.",
    "A significant and strong correlation (higher than 0.5) was found for 8 of the 10 HuP3D metrics compared to the clinical Css.",
    "BCa cell proliferation from fresh or frozen biopsies showed about a 2.5-fold and 3.3-fold growth compared to day 0 at days 3 and 7, respectively.",
    "Cell proliferation of CD44+/EpCAM+ BCa cells from frozen conditions showed about a 2.3-fold and 3.7-fold growth compared to day 0 at days 3 and 7, respectively.",
    "The clinical effective concentration for Arimidex in patients was found in literature to be at 13.7 μg/L (45 µM).",
    "EpCAM+ BCa cells from patient SH-8 with the “resistance” clinical outcome clearly revealed little to no effect of Arimidex at 45 µM.",
    "EpCAM+ BCa cells decreased to 49 and 17% for patients with moderate and strong responses to treatment at Css (45 µM) concentrations, respectively.",
    "HuP3D drug screening assays gave therapeutic responses in only one week, while PDX models will take months."
  ]
}
